steps.title: Prepare DIA-NN Search Output
steps.instruction: Trim the DIA-NN peptide search output file to retain only the following columns: Protein Group, Protein Name, Genes, Protein Description, Peptide Sequence, and Sample Replicate Intensity value (counts, peptide peak area in arbitrary units).

steps.title: Calculate Total Protein Intensity
steps.instruction: Sum all peptide intensity values (counts) to determine the total protein intensity (counts).

substeps.instruction: Export the resulting data table as Full_list_proteins_XXXXXXXXX-xxxxxxx.csv
Generate a file for Experiment Data Depot (EDD) import named Full_list_proteins_EDDformat_XXXXXXXXX-xxxxxxx.csv

steps.title: Generate Protein Intensity Summary
steps.instruction: Calculate the mean, standard deviation (SD), percent coefficient of variation (CV%), and Z-scores (across all samples) for the protein intensities (counts) of the sample replicates.

substeps.instruction: Export the full data table as Full_list_proteins_summary_XXXXXXXXX-xxxxxxx.csv
If a select list of proteins is provided, generate and export a similar summary as Selected_proteins_summary_XXXXXXXXX-xxxxxxx.csv

steps.title: Perform Top3 Protein Quantification
steps.instruction: Calculate absolute protein abundance as fractions of total protein mass using the Top3 quantification method.

substeps.instruction: Filter DIA-NN peptide report data for proteins with three or more peptides identified across all samples
Rank the top 3 peptides by intensity (counts) for each protein in each sample
Calculate mean rankings of peptides in each protein across all samples and filter to the three highest ranked peptides per protein
Calculate protein intensity (counts) by averaging the intensity of these Top3 peptides
Calculate percent total protein abundance: ((intensity of individual protein / sum of all protein intensities in a given sample) * 100)

Export Top3 full peptide list (Top3_Full_list_peptides_used_for_quant_XXXXXXXX-xxxxxx.csv), Top3 full protein list for each replicate (Top3_Full_list_proteins_XXXXXXXX-xxxxxx.csv), and Top3 full list of proteins averaged across replicates (Top3_Full_list_proteins_summary_XXXXXXXX-xxxxxx.csv)

steps.title: Generate Protein Abundance Visualizations
steps.instruction: Create visualizations based on the Top3 quantification results if a list of selected proteins is provided.

substeps.instruction: Generate bar charts (.png, .svg, .plotly) with Proteins on X-axis and % protein abundance (mean) on Y-axis, using SD as error bars
Generate strip charts (.png, .svg, .plotly) with Proteins on X-axis and Protein intensity (counts) from the mean of top 3 peptides on Y-axis
Generate histograms (.png) for each sample with log10 (% protein abundance) bins on X-axis and count of proteins on Y-axis
Generate a jitter plot (.png, .plotly) showing protein distribution across abundance percentiles
If sample names contain timepoint information, generate line charts (.png, .svg, .plotly) with Time on X-axis and % protein abundance (mean) on Y-axis, using SD as error bars

steps.title: Analyze Specific Protein Markers
steps.instruction: If commonly analyzed proteins (e.g., insoluble protein diagnostic marker proteins, proteases, heat shock proteins) are detected, generate corresponding bar charts in .png, .svg, and .plotly formats.

steps.title: Perform Comparative Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Compare two selected samples (A and B) using a Welch's t-Test (scipy ttest_ind_from_stats).

substeps.instruction: Impute missing and zero abundance values with the lowest detected (LOD) value in each sample
Log2 transform abundance values prior to the t-Test
Calculate False Discovery Rate (FDR/q-value) using the Benjamini-Hochberg method (statsmodels.stats.multitest.multipletests)
Define significant proteins as p-value/adjusted p-value < 0.05, with Fold Change > 2 (UP) or < 0.5 (DOWN)

Export results to an Excel file (t-Test_SampleA_OVER_SampleB_XXXXXXXX-xxxxxx.csv) with five sheets: Full t-test output, p-value Significant UP, p-value Significant DOWN, adjusted p-value Significant UP, and adjusted p-value Significant DOWN

steps.title: Generate Volcano Plots
steps.instruction: If a list of selected proteins is provided, generate two sets of volcano plots (.png, .svg, .plotly) for the sample comparison.

substeps.instruction: Plot log2 (Fold change) vs. -log10(p-value)
Plot log2 (Fold change) vs. -log10(adjusted-p-value)
Apply significance cutoffs: Fold Change = 0.5x and 2x (-1 and 1 on log2 axis); p-value and adj-p-value = 0.05 (1.3 on -log10 axis)

steps.title: Perform Quality Control and PCA
steps.instruction: Execute quality control checks and Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

substeps.instruction: Generate bar plots of total proteins and peptides identified/quantified by DIA-NN per sample and cumulatively
Scale data using sklearn StandardScaler fit_transform
Implement PCA using sklearn PCA method, limiting to 4 principal components
Calculate explained variance and cumulative variance for the top two components
Plot 2D PCA graph and Scree graph
Generate peptide CV violin plots and log2 peptide data box plots across sample replicates
